title: Chapter Test
subtitle: Chapter 11 접속사 (p. 147–148)
introKo: 이 연습은 [1–3] 3문항(고르기), [4] 1문항(빈칸 말만 쓰기), [5] 1문항(고르기), [6–8] 3문항(문장 전체 쓰기), [9–10] 2문항(고르기), [11–12] 2문항(고르기), [13–14] 2문항(빈칸 말만 쓰기), [15] 1문항(고르기), [16] 1문항(문장 전체 쓰기)으로 되어 있어요.

sections.ruleKo: 보기 중에서 알맞은 것을 하나 골라 누르세요. (직접 쓰지 않아요.)

items.sectionInstructionKo: [1–3] 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것을 고르세요. 보기 중에서 알맞은 것을 하나 골라 누르세요. (직접 쓰지 않아요.)
items.promptEn: My mom's knee always hurts ________ it's raining outside.

items.sectionInstructionKo: [1–3] 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것을 고르세요. 보기 중에서 알맞은 것을 하나 골라 누르세요. (직접 쓰지 않아요.)
items.promptEn: Don't touch that dog, ________ it will bite you.

items.sectionInstructionKo: [1–3] 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것을 고르세요. 보기 중에서 알맞은 것을 하나 골라 누르세요. (직접 쓰지 않아요.)
items.promptEn: These days, birds are losing their homes ________ people cut down trees.

items.sectionInstructionKo: [4] 다음 중 어법상 알맞지 않은 문장을 모두 고르세요. 알맞은 보기 번호 두 개를 빈칸에 각각 쓰세요.
items.promptEn:
① Brian, as well as I, likes to play baseball.
② Sue is not only a dancer but also a writer.
③ Neither the jeans nor the red skirt fit me well.
④ Either the teachers nor Sora knows his phone number.
⑤ Both my sister and her friend were in the living room.

items.sectionInstructionKo: [5] 다음 밑줄 친 that[That]의 쓰임이 나머지와 다른 하나를 고르세요. 보기 중에서 알맞은 것을 하나 골라 누르세요. (직접 쓰지 않아요.)
items.promptEn:
① He said <u>that</u> math is a useful subject.
② I guess <u>that</u> bike on the road is Jimmy's.
③ It is natural <u>that</u> my sister and I look similar.
④ The problem is <u>that</u> Sammy always puts off her homework.
⑤ <u>That</u> Dorothy didn't get hurt in the car accident is very lucky.
choices: He said that math is a useful subject.
I guess that bike on the road is Jimmy's.
It is natural that my sister and I look similar.
The problem is that Sammy always puts off her homework.
That Dorothy didn't get hurt in the car accident is very lucky.

items.sectionInstructionKo: [6–8] 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 올바르게 배열하세요. 문장 전체를 쓰세요. (첫 단어부터 마침표까지 완전한 문장으로 쓰세요.)
items.promptEn:
Eva는 너무 바빠서 자신의 생일도 잊어버렸다.
(so / forgot / she / busy / that)
→ Eva was ________ her own birthday.
accept: Eva was so busy that she forgot her own birthday.

items.sectionInstructionKo: [6–8] 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 올바르게 배열하세요. 문장 전체를 쓰세요. (첫 단어부터 마침표까지 완전한 문장으로 쓰세요.)
items.promptEn:
영화가 언제 시작하는지 아세요?
(the movie / when / starts)
→ Do you know ________?
accept: Do you know when the movie starts?

items.sectionInstructionKo: [6–8] 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 올바르게 배열하세요. 문장 전체를 쓰세요. (첫 단어부터 마침표까지 완전한 문장으로 쓰세요.)
items.promptEn:
너는 Jane이 저녁으로 무엇을 먹었다고 추측하니?
(Jane / guess / you / ate / what / do)
________ for dinner?
accept: What do you guess Jane ate for dinner?
What do you guess Jane ate

items.sectionInstructionKo: [9–10] 다음 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것을 고르세요. 보기 중에서 알맞은 것을 하나 골라 누르세요. (직접 쓰지 않아요.)
items.promptEn:
• ________ I didn't check my phone, I missed his call.
• I've never seen her ________ she moved here.

items.sectionInstructionKo: [9–10] 다음 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것을 고르세요. 보기 중에서 알맞은 것을 하나 골라 누르세요. (직접 쓰지 않아요.)
items.promptEn:
• I prefer dogs, ________ my sister prefers cats.
• Mary dropped the vase ________ she was cleaning the shelf.

items.sectionInstructionKo: [11–12] 다음 중 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것을 고르세요. 보기 중에서 알맞은 것을 하나 골라 누르세요. (직접 쓰지 않아요.)
items.promptEn:
• I set my alarm (A) I went to sleep.
• My dad likes to watch a movie (B) it gives him happiness.

items.sectionInstructionKo: [11–12] 다음 중 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것을 고르세요. 보기 중에서 알맞은 것을 하나 골라 누르세요. (직접 쓰지 않아요.)
items.promptEn:
• Ask me (A) you don't know the way.
• (B) you take some rest, you will get sick.

items.sectionInstructionKo: [13–14] 다음 밑줄 친 부분을 바르게 고쳐 쓰세요. 빈칸에 들어갈 말만 쓰세요. (문장 전체를 쓰지 마세요.)
items.promptEn: If you <u>will stay</u> at home on the weekend, I will visit you.
accept: If you stay at home on the weekend, I will visit you.

items.sectionInstructionKo: [13–14] 다음 밑줄 친 부분을 바르게 고쳐 쓰세요. 빈칸에 들어갈 말만 쓰세요. (문장 전체를 쓰지 마세요.)
items.promptEn: Neither my brother nor I <u>were</u> late for school although we woke up late.
accept: Neither my brother nor I was late
Neither my brother nor I was

items.sectionInstructionKo: [15] 다음 중 <보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 의미가 같은 것을 고르세요. 보기 중에서 알맞은 것을 하나 골라 누르세요. (직접 쓰지 않아요.)
items.promptEn:
<보기> <u>As</u> my younger sister grew up, she started to look like our mom.
① I like this flower <u>as</u> its scent is so sweet.
② <u>As</u> it was too noisy, I couldn't hear his voice.
③ <u>As</u> summer comes near, the sun rises earlier.
④ Diana took some medicine, <u>as</u> the doctor told her to.
⑤ <u>As</u> I didn't visit my grandparents last Chuseok, they miss me.
choices: I like this flower as its scent is so sweet.
As it was too noisy, I couldn't hear his voice.
As summer comes near, the sun rises earlier.
Diana took some medicine, as the doctor told her to.
As I didn't visit my grandparents last Chuseok, they miss me.

items.sectionInstructionKo: [16] 다음 대화를 읽고 주어진 표현을 사용하여 문장을 완성하세요. 문장 전체를 쓰세요. (첫 단어부터 마침표까지 완전한 문장으로 쓰세요.)
items.promptEn:
Clair: Why did you look so tired this morning?
Eric: I woke up too late. So I had to run to school.
→ Eric woke up ________.
accept: Eric woke up so late that he had to run to school.
Eric woke up so late that he had to run.
so late that he had to run to school
so late that he had to run
